title: Drag race · Level 1: The class robot
brief: Sprint down the lane and stop with the whole robot inside the green box (2000 to 2200 mm from the start line). The run ends when the robot has stood still for 0.5 s after it first moved, when it touches the far wall, or at 20 s. 50 for stopping in the box, up to 40 for speed (the moment it came to rest against par), 10 for touching no wall; a robot that stops short or overshoots scores 0. Par: 4.0 s.

score.run: if(reached, round(50 + 40 * min(1, par / max(time, 0.001)) + if(touches == 0, 10, 0), 1), 0)
